name: cavemio-usage-limits
title: Usage limits
description: What an agent has left: the context window split by what fills it, and each plan limit with its share and a live reset countdown.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Every figure is real text: tokens, shares, reset times; the bars are hidden from assistive tech.
- The context heading is a button with aria-expanded controlling the breakdown, which is inert while folded.
- Amber and red always come with a figure, and "Limit reached" is spelled out.
- The countdown re-renders once a minute on the whole minute, and only after mounting, so a server render never shows a wrong time.
- Installs Number roll. It sizes to its own width; with reduced motion bars and figures change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: The context split by what fills it
features.description: One bar shows the system prompt, tools, files and conversation, with a 2px gap between the parts.

features.title: A breakdown on demand
features.description: The chevron folds the list of parts open with tokens and shares. Pointing at a part steps the others back.

features.title: Plan limits with reset times
features.description: Under a day away it counts down, with the minutes rolling. Further out it gives the day and time.

features.title: It warns before it runs out
features.description: A bar turns amber past 80% and red at the limit, where “Limit reached” opens beside the share.

features.title: Every figure is real text
features.description: Tokens, shares and reset times are text for screen readers. The bars are decoration.

features.title: Safe on the server
features.description: The countdown starts after mount, so a server render never shows a wrong time, and the card sizes to its own width.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, every bar grows from the left (900ms, staggered) and every figure rolls up from zero.

states.title: breakdown
states.description: The context heading is a disclosure: the chevron turns and the list of parts folds open (420ms) with each part’s tokens and share. Pointing at a part or its row dims the others.

states.title: countdown
states.description: A reset under a day away reads "Resets in 2 h 46 min"; the clock ticks on each whole minute and the minutes roll down. Further away it reads "Resets Tue 3:00 pm".

states.title: status
states.description: At 80% a bar and its share turn amber; at 100% they turn red and "Limit reached" folds open beside the share.
